Hi Sophie — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. Short answers up front, and then a suggested next step.

- Marketplace: yes, we support marketplace billing via AWS and GCP in most regions. Marketplace commitments typically go through their marketplace pricing model and billing cadence; good when you want consolidated cloud billing and quicker procurement.
- Direct billing (Redwood): we can accept card for pilot contracts up to the agreed spend threshold. For enterprise pilots or commitments, customers often prefer PO/invoiced terms. We support Net30 invoicing and can do Net45 on request for established customers.
- Signatory path: Redwood standard practice is for the commercial order to be signed by our Head of Revenue or a delegated Sales Ops signatory for pilots; enterprise MSAs are signed by Legal/COO depending on terms. I cc'd Ben (sales lead) and Laura (rev ops) to help map exact signatory roster and approve any exceptions.

Attachments: attached a short vendor-onboarding checklist, a draft SOW template, and our W9 for your vendor team to triage.

Suggested next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether procurement prefers marketplace subscription or a vendor invoice/PO? (This changes the routing and lead time.)
2) Please share the name/email of your budget owner / economic buyer so Ben can do a short pricing/ROI readout with them.
3) If PO is required, Laura can share our standard billing contacts and portal instructions; if card is ok, we can provide a quick setup link.

If helpful, Ben and I can join a 30-min procurement call later this week to walk the checklist.

Best,

Thanks Sophie — quick follow-ups from our side: 

- If ClareHealth wants to stay on cloud marketplace, expected time-to-activate is ~2 business days after marketplace listing checks. Pricing will be list-based (no custom MSA) unless you need committed capacity.
- If you prefer vendor invoicing (PO), lead time is usually 7–10 business days for onboarding + payment cycle alignment. For pilots where you want to use a card, we can enable card billing immediately.

To help procurement map approvals internally, here's who we typically need to see on your side and what we will provide: 
- Economic buyer (VP/Product): short ROI deck and pilot metrics
- Finance sponsor (Procurement/Finance): vendor form, W9, SOC2 link, billing contact
- Signatory (legal/finance): MSA or commercial order sign-off (we can accept delegated signatory for pilots)

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):

4) Mina to share SOW draft and timeline for a pilot (attached).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.
